marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 0.1 秒, 决胜瞬间! = The Game Point | 0.1 miao, jue sheng shun jian! = The Game Point

Ye Yizheng had a secret. No one knows that he has a crusher in his head that crushes all the knowledge he hears in his head. This makes him different from the rest of the world, and gives him the nickname ‘Stupid Dummy’. Luckily for him, there was a girl who stood up for him. She becomes his beacon of light, clearing away the darkness and keeping him motivated. One day, he accidentally mastered the method of memorising numbers by making up stories with the characters in the manga, thus unveiling a corner of the fantasy world. With his own ‘sword’ in hand, he embarks on a journey of adventure that will take him ever forward!
